    AlertBroadcastManager
    Public API for pushing real-time alerts to connected clients.

    Translates the public AlertBroadcastManager API into calls on TWO internal service classes: it pushes the live event via AlertBroadcastService AND records it in the recipient's inbox via NotificationInboxService.

    Internal class grouping the live-broadcast use cases: pushing task update, assignment, status, and remote-relay events out over the websocket connection.

    Mini-controller for the Notification, Alert Stream invalid input: '&' Reporting module.
    AModuleController
    Optional shared base for module mini-controllers, mirroring ballworld.controller.ABaseController: gives every module controller a shared system logger for free (via ILoggerControl.getSharedLogger(), the same singleton BallWorld's own WebSocketManager/MessageRouter already use) instead of each module wiring its own.
